description: Read a DXF drawing (ASCII, R12 to current) and summarise it: DXF version, units, layers with how many entities each, entity types, drawing extents and the text found on it (room names, labels, title block). Runs locally. Use it to tell what a drawing contains before placing it next to a model with open_drawings. DWG is detected but not read: ask the user to save it as DXF.

maxTexts.description: How many text strings to return.

source.description: Path to a local file (absolute, or relative to where the server runs) or a public http(s) URL.

name: read_dxf
title: Summarise a DXF drawing
